correctness.rationale: The cited exact h=4 rational series reduces to q^7(1-q)R(q)Q(q)/((1-q^6)(1-q^8)), symbolically verified independently. K=(1-q)Q/((1-q^6)(1-q^8)) has nonnegative coefficients because q(n) is nondecreasing. Its differences are a convolution of the known second differences e_n of q(n), which are nonnegative at n>=5; all negative e_1 and e_4 terms in degrees >=11 inject into distinct positive terms e_9/e_5 or e_12/e_0, respectively, with only degrees 1,4,7,10 excluded. The displayed R coefficient expression then has nonnegative terms for n>=27; independent Young-diagram enumeration verifies all 0<=n<=26 and the unique negative at 8. Infinite conclusion is not from a finite experiment.
